segments.title: Brain cells OFF: how much less sleep?
segments.say: Scientists switched off some brain cells in mice. How much less did they sleep? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: About 70% LESS!
segments.say: About seventy percent less! That's in mice, not people.

segments.title: Cells that build sleepiness
segments.say: These cells get more active the longer the mice stay awake.

segments.title: Turned on: deeper sleep
segments.say: Turn them on, and the mice sleep longer and deeper.

segments.title: Source: Nature
segments.say: The study is in the journal Nature.
